findings.detail: throws ERR_OPTION_NOT_IMPLEMENTED for the ALPNProtocols, enableTrace, minDHSize and pskCallback options, and for rejectUnauthorized: false. It throws for checkServerIdentity only while the throw_on_not_implemented_tls_options flag is on. That flag is on from compatibility date 2026-06-16, and no_throw_on_not_implemented_tls_options turns it off. edgefit uses your date and flags for checkServerIdentity
